thesis: The page is a kiln-fired brick map of St. Louis: each neighborhood is a clay color, and scrolling fires the bricks from river to ridge as the signature maker's-mark stamps each section.

signature.name: Maker's-Mark Stamp
signature.summary: A CSS-drawn brick face with a recessed frog stamp carrying a two-letter section code and number; presses in on scroll entry. Reused in hero, neighborhood cards, service cards, reviews, and footer.

motion.intro: Neighborhoods on the SVG map fill with their brick colors westward from the river in staggered 80ms opacity transitions; headline rises. Skippable; instant under reduced motion.
stories: Maker's-mark stamp presses into each section header on entry (scaleY .95→1, shadow deepen, 400ms ease-out).
Brick-life timeline frames fill via clip-path wipe as you scroll through the pinned story; six static frames under reduced motion.
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows from left via scaleX(0→1) on links and buttons.
